title: From Noise to Diversity: Random Embedding Injection in LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2605.11936v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent soft prompt research has tried to improve reasoning by inserting trained vectors into LLM inputs, yet whether the gain comes from the learned content or from the act of injection itself has not been carefully separated. We study Random Soft Prompts (RSPs), which drop the training step entirely and append a freshly drawn sequence of random embedding vectors to the input. Each RSP vector is sampled from an isotropic Gaussian fitted to the entrywise mean and variance of the pretrained embedding table; the sequence carries no learned content, and yet reaches accuracy comparable to optimized soft prompts on math reasoning benchmarks in several settings. translated_title: 从噪声到多样性：LLM 推理中的随机嵌入注入
translated_abstract: 近期的软提示研究试图通过在 LLM 输入中插入训练得到的向量来提升推理能力，但收益究竟来自学习到的内容还是注入行为本身，此前尚未被仔细区分。我们研究了随机软提示，它完全省去了训练步骤，直接在输入后附加一段全新采样的随机嵌入向量序列。每个 RSP 向量从各向同性高斯分布中采样，该分布根据预训练嵌入表的逐条目均值和方差拟合得到；该序列不携带任何学习到的内容，却在多种设置下在数学推理基准上取得了与优化后的软提示相当的准确率。其机制分为两个阶段：由于注意力必须吸收一个前所未见的随机位置，前几个生成 token 上的分布被拉平，推理轨迹随之产生分支；而随着生成继续，这种影响自然稀释，使回复逐渐……
tldr: 该论文提出完全无需训练的随机软提示（RSP），仅通过向 LLM 输入注入随机嵌入向量即可在数学推理上达到与训练软提示相当的准确率，其机制在于随机位置拉平了初期生成分布、增加了推理轨迹的多样性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Random Soft Prompts (RSPs)—training-free, freshly sampled random embedding vectors appended to LLM inputs—that match optimized soft prompts on math reasoning by flattening early-token distributions and thereby diversifying reasoning trajectories.
